title: Add Storybook stories for all 14 plugin packages
body:
## 📚 Add Storybook Stories for All Plugin Components

### 🎯 Task Complete ✅
Successfully evaluated the current Storybook setup and added comprehensive stories for **all 14 missing plugin components** as requested in the issue (评估目前的storybook，为所有缺少的组件插件添加story).

### 📊 Summary
Created **14 new story files** with **41 individual story examples** covering all plugin components in the ObjectUI ecosystem.

### ✅ All Plugin Components Now Have Stories

#### Standalone Plugins (9 packages)
- [x] **plugin-aggrid** - AG Grid component (`aggrid`)
  - 3 stories: Default, WithPagination, AlpineTheme
  - Demonstrates data grids with sorting, filtering, pagination, and theming
- [x] **plugin-calendar** - Calendar components (`calendar-view`)
  - 2 stories: CalendarView, MonthView
  - Shows event calendars with different view modes
- [x] **plugin-charts** - Chart components (`bar-chart`, `chart`)
  - 4 stories: BarChart, MultiSeriesChart, LineChart, AreaChart
  - Covers all major chart types with sample data
- [x] **plugin-chatbot** - Chatbot component (`chatbot`)
  - 3 stories: Default, WithTimestamps, CustomerSupport
  - Interactive chat interfaces with auto-response demo
- [x] **plugin-dashboard** - Dashboard components (`dashboard`, `metric`)
  - 2 stories: Default, WithCards
  - Dashboard layouts with metric widgets
- [x] **plugin-editor** - Code Editor component (`code-editor`)
  - 6 stories: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, JSON, ReadOnly, LightTheme
  - Monaco editor with multiple language support
- [x] **plugin-kanban** - Kanban Board component (`kanban`)
  - 2 stories: Default, ProjectManagement
  - Drag-and-drop task boards with column limits
- [x] **plugin-markdown** - Markdown renderer (`markdown`)
  - 4 stories: Default, CompleteExample, CodeExample, TableExample
  - Rich markdown rendering with code blocks and tables
- [x] **plugin-timeline** - Timeline components (`timeline`)
  - 4 stories: Vertical, Horizontal, Gantt, ProductRoadmap
  - Multiple timeline visualizations including Gantt charts

#### ObjectStack-Integrated Plugins (5 packages)
- [x] **plugin-form** - Object Form component (`object-form`)
  - 3 stories: BasicSchema, WithSections, ComplexFields
  - Form builders with validation and field types
- [x] **plugin-gantt** - Gantt component (`object-gantt`)
  - 2 stories: ProjectSchedule, SimpleGantt
  - Project timeline management with dependencies
- [x] **plugin-grid** - Object Grid component (`object-grid`)
  - 3 stories: UserGrid, ProductGrid, WithActions
  - Data tables with CRUD operations
- [x] **plugin-map** - Map component (`object-map`)
  - 2 stories: StoreLocations, DeliveryRoutes
  - Interactive maps with location markers
- [x] **plugin-view** - Object View component (`object-view`)
  - 3 stories: UserProfile, ProductDetails, OrderSummary
  - Detail views for various data types

### 🔧 Implementation Details
- **Location**: `packages/components/src/stories-json/`
- **Pattern**: Followed existing conventions using `SchemaRenderer` component
- **Format**: JSON-based component schemas demonstrating real-world use cases
- **Structure**: Each story file follows the same template as existing stories
- **Category**: All stories organized under "JSON/Plugins/" in Storybook

### 🐛 Fixed Build Issue
- **Problem**: CSS preload failures and component rendering issues in deployed Storybook
- **Root Cause**: Plugin packages have circular dependencies with `@object-ui/components`
- **Solution**: Added Vite aliases in `.storybook/main.ts` to resolve plugin packages from source during Storybook build
- **Result**: Storybook now builds successfully with all plugin components properly registered

### ✨ Quality Assurance
- [x] **Build**: Storybook builds successfully without errors
- [x] **Type Safety**: TypeScript type-checking passes with no errors
- [x] **Code Review**: Automated review found no issues
- [x] **Security**: CodeQL scan found 0 alerts
- [x] **UI Verification**: All 14 plugin categories visible in Storybook sidebar
- [x] **Documentation**: All 41 individual stories accessible and properly documented
- [x] **CSS Assets**: Plugin CSS properly bundled and loaded

### 📝 Files Modified/Added
```
packages/components/
├── .storybook/
│   ├── main.ts (modified - added Vite aliases for plugins)
│   └── preview.ts (modified - imports all plugin packages)
├── package.json (no changes - avoided circular dependencies)
└── src/stories-json/ (14 new files)
    ├── aggrid.stories.tsx
    ├── calendar.stories.tsx
    ├── charts.stories.tsx
    ├── chatbot.stories.tsx
    ├── code-editor.stories.tsx
    ├── dashboard.stories.tsx
    ├── kanban.stories.tsx
    ├── markdown.stories.tsx
    ├── object-form.stories.tsx
    ├── object-gantt.stories.tsx
    ├── object-grid.stories.tsx
    ├── object-map.stories.tsx
    ├── object-view.stories.tsx
    └── timeline.stories.tsx
```

### 🎓 Story Coverage
Each plugin now includes stories demonstrating:
- ✅ Default/basic usage
- ✅ Common configurations and variants
- ✅ Real-world use cases and examples
- ✅ Different data structures and formats
- ✅ Interactive features where applicable

### 🔍 Before & After
**Before**: 35 story files, 0 plugin stories, build failures
**After**: 49 story files, 14 plugin stories covering all 14 plugin packages, successful builds

### 🚀 Usage
All stories are now accessible in Storybook under the "Plugins" category:
```bash
cd packages/components
pnpm run storybook
# Navigate to http://localhost:6006
# Click "Plugins" to see all new stories
```

### 📚 Documentation Value
These stories serve as:
1. **API Documentation**: Shows available props and schema structure
2. **Usage Examples**: Demonstrates how to use each plugin
3. **Visual Reference**: Provides quick preview of component capabilities
4. **Testing Ground**: Allows interactive experimentation with component props

### 🔒 Security Summary
- No security vulnerabilities introduced
- All code follows existing patterns and best practices
- CodeQL analysis: 0 alerts
